title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.12293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic

translated_title: 机器学习与高能核物理的相遇：从模式识别到物理融合的发现
translated_abstract: 机器学习在高能核物理中正进入一个新阶段，物理知识被更直接地融入数据分析、模拟和物理推断之中。本小型综述聚焦于过去几年中已趋于成熟的发展。早期的应用侧重于事件分类、模式识别以及针对特定可观测量的代理模型，而近期的工作已转向物理融合的工作流程：包括经校准的贝叶斯方法提取QCD物质性质、从重离子对撞和中子星数据推断致密物质状态方程、生成式事件建模、微弱物理信号的神经展开、可微分逆问题求解器、规范等变与基于扩散模型的格点场采样器，以及全息QCD中模型函数的神经重建。我们综述了机器学习在重离子碰撞、中子星物理、格点量子场论和全息（QCD）等领域的最新应用。
tldr: 本综述指出机器学习在高能核物理中正从传统的事件分类与模式识别，演进为将物理知识深度融入的工作流程，涵盖QCD物质性质提取、致密物质状态方程推断、生成式事件建模、神经展开、可微分逆求解器及全息QCD重建等前沿方向。
en_tdlr: This mini-review shows that machine learning in high-energy nuclear physics is evolving from event classification and pattern recognition toward physics-integrated workflows, encompassing Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference, generative event modeling, neural unfolding, differentiable inverse solvers, and neural reconstruction in holographic QCD.
